title: Re: Abaddon
html:
Quest Giver: Ol' Chuck Pail

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Kill Abaddon in the Cleft of the Searing Knight and return to Ol' Chuck Pail in The Embercore Portal.

Quest Reward: Gold and 4 King's Coins

Return to: Ol' Chuck Pail

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: The Embercore Path

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Kill Abaddon in the Cleft of the Searing Knight and return to Ol' Chuck Pail in The Embercore Portal.

Offer:

Come on, Dungeon Runner, don't just sit there. You shouldn't just sit around and wait for The Embercore Path to reopen under Wally Wanka! You should be in there helping out. I just heard that Abaddon has been seen sneaking back into the dungeon and has been scarring off some of the cleanup crew. Would you mind taking care of him?

Make your way to the Cleft of the Searing Knight and slay Abaddon for me. I know you've done it already, but have I mentioned how much I hate that monster? I hate him about as much as I love candy. Alot! Take Abaddon down and return to me here in The Embercore Portal when you are through.

Turn-in:

You got him again? Excellent! I can picture the look on his face when he respawns in the monster graveyard, wondering how he got there. Hahahaha! Let me know if you want to give him that look again.

Objectives:

  • Kill Abaddon

Client level range: 46–46
